camel_example: aliyun live ModifyLiveAIStudio --region cn-hangzhou --MattingType complex --StudioName stu02 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MattingLayout '{"PositionY":0.0,"HeightNormalized":0.5,"PositionX":0.0}'
description_en: This API is used to modify the specified virtual studio template
description_zh: 本接口用于修改指定的虚拟演播模板
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-live-ai-studio --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --studio-name stu02 --matting-type complex --matting-layout PositionY=0.0 HeightNormalized=0.5 PositionX=0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLiveAIStudio

parameters.help_en: Virtual studio template name, same as the StudioName parameter in the create API
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟演播模板名称，与创建接口中的入参StudioName相同
parameters.name: studio_name

parameters.help_en:
Preview screen height, unit: px.

The preview screen width x height only supports the following specifications:

Landscape Smooth 360P 640x360
Portrait Smooth 360P 360x640
Landscape Standard Definition 480P 854x480
Portrait Standard Definition 480P 480x854
Landscape HD 720P 1280x720
Portrait HD 720P 720x1280
Landscape Full HD 1080P 1920x1080
Portrait Full HD 1080P 1080x1920
parameters.help_zh:
预览画面高度，单位：px

预览画面宽度x高度仅支持以下规格：

横屏流畅 360P 640x360
竖屏流畅 360P 360x640
横屏标清 480P 854x480
竖屏标清 480P 480x854
横屏高清 720P 1280x720
竖屏高清 720P 720x1280
横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080
竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en:
Background material type:
VOD: Video on demand
PIC: Image
LIVE: Live stream
parameters.help_zh:
背景素材类型：
VOD 点播视频
PIC 图片
LIVE 直播流
parameters.name: background_type

parameters.help_en: VOD resource ID of the background material, obtained from the VOD console
parameters.help_zh: 背景素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
parameters.name: background_resource_id

parameters.help_en: Resource access URL of the background material
parameters.name: background_resource_url

parameters.help_en:
Multimedia material type:
VOD: Video on demand
PIC: Image
LIVE: Live stream
parameters.help_zh:
多媒体素材类型：
VOD 点播视频
PIC 图片
LIVE 直播流
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en: VOD resource ID of the multimedia material, obtained from the VOD console
parameters.help_zh: 多媒体素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
parameters.name: media_resource_id

parameters.help_en: Resource access URL of the multimedia material. Either this or the resource ID should be provided
parameters.help_zh: 多媒体素材的资源访问url，与资源id二选一传入
parameters.name: media_resource_url

fields.help_en: Normalized height value of the material, which is the height ratio of the material to the background. Value range: 0~1
fields.help_zh: 素材的高度归一化值。即素材与背景的高度比。取值：0~1
fields.name: height_normalized

fields.help_en: Position parameter, X coordinate. Value range: 0~1. The material position uses the upper-left corner as the reference point
fields.help_zh: 位置参数，坐标x。取值：0~1。素材位置以左上角为基准点
fields.name: position_x

fields.help_en: Position parameter, Y coordinate. Value range: 0~1. The material position uses the upper-left corner as the reference point
fields.help_zh: 位置参数，坐标y。取值：0~1。素材位置以左上角为基准点
fields.name: position_y

parameters.help_zh: 多媒体素材的位置布局信息

Matting type:

blue: Blue screen matting
complex: Real-scene matting

green 绿幕抠图
blue 蓝幕抠图

fields.name: position_x

fields.help_en: Position parameter, Y coordinate. Value range: 0~1. The material position uses the upper-left corner as the reference point
fields.help_zh: 位置参数，坐标y。取值：0~1。素材位置以左上角为基准点
